summary: The change adds the required AUTH_DEV_LOCAL_KV opt-in to the reset-local-users task and a regression test exercising that task under a clean environment.

evidence: deno.json line 7 prefixes the reset-local-users task with AUTH_DEV_LOCAL_KV=true.
src/store_startup_test.ts adds a regression test that runs deno task reset-local-users with a clean environment and asserts exit code 0 and Cancelled output.
